$comment: Cursor plugin hooks (default discovery path: hooks/hooks.json at the plugin root). Command paths are relative to this file per Cursor's hooks convention; cursor-hook.mjs translates Cursor payloads and delegates to the hook.cjs bundled next to it (the shared membase stdio runtime). LIVE VERIFICATION PENDING before announcing installs — plugin-hook command cwd behavior has known inconsistencies; verify against a real Cursor install. With a disk login (stdio bundle mode) it captures + flushes in real time; without one (HTTP mode) it still spools captures locally and announces the pending count at session start. State lives in ~/.membase/cursor by default; set MEMBASE_DATA_DIR to override.
